verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a first-party MCP server that agents can connect to, confirmed by a probe of its 'using agents' page. Its documented scope is limited to searching and retrieving documentation content, not acting on MoonPay's platform (quotes, transactions, customers). Missing for 10: MCP tools exposing MoonPay platform/API operations, connection/setup and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The documentation includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve content.
